item.description: THE MEDEA PROJECT – LIVE AT DINGWALLS The Medea Project’s last studio album, Kharon, was an emphatic statement of the band’s identity. It drew out all the finest elements of their 2020 Sisyphus debut album, added the confidence to experiment and explore that was so clearly represented on 2023s Reflections EP and infused the blend with vision, imagination and an all enveloping atmosphere.
